reason: The contract (problem.txt) explicitly requires abs(actual[i] - log(1+x[i])) <= 1e-6 with zero relative tolerance for every finite FP16 value > -1, as a single global verdict. An exhaustive probe (t9) over all 47104 legal FP16 values found max absolute error 1.3007e-06 (worst at x=3378, ref 8.1253; top errors also at x=3374, 27008, 13496), above the 1e-6 tolerance — a confirmed in-scope contract violation. The boundary/extreme probe (t10) independently confirms errors above 1e-6 in the large-exponent region (error at x=65504 itself is only 1.4e-07, so the defect is in the large-x mid-range, consistent with the truncated/rounded polynomial and FP32 summation in c1/c2). This is not an acceptable rounding-order or declared-precision deviation: the contract mandates a fixed absolute tolerance throughout the entire legal domain, and the kernel demonstrably exceeds it. Claim c3 (near x=-1 / subnormals) was rebutted (max error 8.58e-07 there), which does not affect the verdict. All claims are resolved; Skeptic signed off with no new claims after reviewing the latest evidence.
